stories.title: Mãe encontrada morta em casa após deixar a filha com parentes e não voltar para buscá-la levou choque, diz polícia

en.title: Mother found dead at home after leaving daughter with relatives and failing to return to pick her up caused shock, police say
en.summary: A 35-year-old woman was found dead in her home after leaving her 4-year-old daughter with relatives to work. According to the Scientific Police, the death was caused by electrical shock.

stories.title: Rodrigo Cass, artista plástico, morre no Rio aos 43 anos

en.title: Rodrigo Cass, plastic artist, dies in Rio at 43 years old
en.summary: Plastic artist Rodrigo Cass, 43, drowned at Ipanema Beach in Rio de Janeiro. Despite being rescued by firefighters and taken to hospital, he did not survive.

stories.title: Lula diz que 5 ministros do STF estão envolvidos com Master e avalia que crise respinga na eleição

en.title: Lula says 5 STF ministers are involved with Master and assesses that crisis spills into election
en.summary: President Lula stated that five Supreme Court ministers are involved with Master and believes the crisis may impact the election.

stories.title: Milton Leite não se entrega após 24h e polícia vai até Sorocaba para tentar prender ex-vereador

en.title: Milton Leite does not surrender after 24 hours and police go to Sorocaba to try to arrest former councilman
en.summary: Former councilman Milton Leite failed to surrender within the given timeframe, prompting police to travel to Sorocaba to attempt his arrest.

stories.title: Rodrigo Cass, artista plástico em ascensão no mercado, morre afogado aos 43 anos

en.title: Rodrigo Cass, rising plastic artist in the market, dies drowned at 43 years old
en.summary: Plastic artist Rodrigo Cass drowned while swimming at Copacabana beach in Rio de Janeiro at age 43. His representation gallery confirmed the death.

stories.title: Candidatos não poderão ser presos a partir deste sábado

en.title: Candidates will not be able to be arrested starting this Saturday
en.summary: Candidates running in the 2026 elections cannot be arrested or detained starting Saturday, as provided by Electoral Code for the 15 days before the October 4 first round, extending 48 hours after voting ends.

stories.title: Defesa de Daniel Vorcaro pede revogação de prisão preventiva a Fachin

en.title: Daniel Vorcaro's defense requests revocation of preventive detention from Fachin
en.summary: The legal team of former banker Daniel Vorcaro requested Supreme Court president Edson Fachin to revoke his preventive detention. Vorcaro is under investigation for public agent corruption and billion-dollar financial fraud.

stories.title: Quatro cassinos clandestinos são alvo de operação da Polícia Civil em bairros nobres de São Paulo

en.title: Four clandestine casinos are target of Civil Police operation in upscale neighborhoods of São Paulo
en.summary: Civil Police conducted an operation targeting four illegal casinos located in affluent areas of São Paulo.

stories.title: Lula diz que crise no STF respinga na eleição e culpa Bolsonaro pelo caso Master

en.title: Lula says STF crisis affects election and blames Bolsonaro for Master case
en.summary: President Lula stated that a crisis involving a financial fraud scandal at Brazil's Supreme Court impacts the final stage of the election campaign, attributing responsibility to former president Jair Bolsonaro.

stories.title: Defesa de Vorcaro pede revogação de prisão preventiva

en.title: Vorcaro's defense requests revocation of preventive detention
en.summary: Lawyers for Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Master Bank, requested that the Supreme Court president revoke his preventive detention, citing institutional crisis and uncertainty in a major investigation.

stories.title: Operação policial fecha casas de jogos de azar em 4 bairros de São Paulo

en.title: Police operation closes illegal gambling establishments in 4 São Paulo neighborhoods
en.summary: São Paulo's Strategic Police Operations Department conducted raids against clandestine gambling operations across four neighborhoods in the state capital.

stories.title: Eleições 2026: candidatos não podem ser presos a partir de sábado

en.title: Candidates in 2026 elections cannot be arrested starting Saturday
en.summary: Registered candidates in the 2026 elections receive legal protection against arrest or detention beginning Saturday, according to electoral law.

stories.title: Mbappé troca a Nike pela On; o que isso significa para as ações do setor esportivo

en.title: Mbappé switches from Nike to On; what this means for sportswear sector stocks
en.summary: A major sports star ended his Nike partnership to sign with On Holding, a Swiss sportswear company. On's stock fell despite the high-profile endorsement deal, as investor concerns about the company's business growth persisted.

stories.title: Como Putin pode usar a seu favor o resultado das eleições na Rússia?

en.title: How can Putin use Russia's election results to his advantage?
en.summary: Russians are voting in a three-day parliamentary election where the pro-government United Russia party is expected to maintain dominance in a tightly controlled political system that excluded most anti-war candidates.

stories.title: Justiça homologa plano de recuperação extrajudicial de R$ 3,4 bilhões da Andrade Gutierrez

en.title: Court approves Andrade Gutierrez's 3.4 billion reais extrajudicial recovery plan
en.summary: A Minas Gerais court approved two extrajudicial recovery plans for six companies in the Andrade Gutierrez group, with the main engineering company addressing 3.4 billion reais in debt. This is the second such restructuring in under four years.

stories.title: Além do Digimais: Veja as 10 instituições financeiras com maiores prejuízos no 1º semestre

en.title: Beyond Digimais: See the 10 financial institutions with largest losses in first half
en.summary: Digimais posted the worst loss in Brazil's financial sector in the first half of the year at 581.4 million reais. Overall, 319 financial institutions including cooperatives reported losses during the same period.

stories.title: Anthropic monta laboratório de biologia para acelerar experimentos baseados em IA

en.title: Anthropic sets up biology lab to accelerate AI-based experiments
en.summary: Anthropic has established a physical biology laboratory in the San Francisco Bay Area to advance its artificial intelligence applications in pharmaceutical science. The company aims to develop treatments for rare diseases and move beyond computational simulations into practical laboratory work.
